name: macbook-scroll
title: Macbook Scroll
description: A flat-shaded dark laptop with a rounded screen lid, a deck of tiny keys and a trackpad. Scrolling swings the lid open, enlarges the whole machine and reveals an analytics dashboard on the screen.
use: Showing a desktop app or dashboard screenshot inside a recognisable laptop on a landing page.
avoid: Small screens: below 768px the machine shrinks and the dense key labels become unreadable.
a11y: The screenshot has empty alt text, and the scroll animation ignores reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark laptop mockup built from flat shapes, with a rounded screen lid above a grey keyboard deck full of tiny keys and a trackpad. The screen holds a green-tinted analytics dashboard with bar and line charts and a white title bar.
behaves: As the page scrolls the lid swings open from behind the base, the whole machine scales up and the dashboard screen is revealed while the heading above fades and drifts away.
customise: Title, screen image src and an optional badge come from props; the lid geometry, keyboard and all colours are hardcoded.
weight: moderate: Over a hundred key elements plus several scroll transforms; no canvas loop.
demo: Title Your dashboard, opened on scroll. Built with Tailwind CSS, over a green analytics dashboard with charts.
issues: The screen image has empty alt text, so screen readers get nothing about the dashboard.
Key labels are 5px and unreadable at the rendered scale.
In frame 1 the screen is still hidden behind the dark lid shell.
polishWhy: Convincing laptop and a smooth open; tiny key labels blur and the screenshot lacks alt text.
